targets.title: Comparison between the Test of Memory Malingering (TOMM) and the Nonverbal Symptom Validity Test (NV-MSVT) in adults with disability claims.
targets.evidence_quote: Green (2011) thus concluded that the NV-MSVT is more sensitive to poor effort than the TOMM. The current investigation is an attempt to replicate and extend the latter study.
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, results closely matched those of the Green (in press) study and extend the evidence that the NV-MSVT possesses better sensitivity to poor effort than the TOMM.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict explicitly states close replication. Main text consistently identifies the single-author Green (2011) study, distinguishing it from the multi-author in-press chapter present elsewhere in references.
